summary: Piecewise evaluation of a tire friction curve from a slip input (double at this+0x19C). Saturation: returns 58.5 when slip >= 4.4 and 0.0 when slip <= 0.0. Otherwise clamps the negative ramp v2 = max(slip - 0.4, 0.0), clamps the upper input to 4.0, and returns (TrigTableLookup(this) * (v3 * 0.25 - v2 * 0.25) + v2 * 0.25) * 58.5, i.e. a table-shaped interpolation between the two ramp arms scaled by 58.5.

operations.description: Saturation clamp: when the slip input (this+0x19C) is >= 4.4 return the saturated output 58.5 immediately.
No-slip clamp: when the slip input (this+0x19C) is <= 0.0 return 0.0 immediately.
Negative ramp arm: v2 = slip - 0.4 (inflection threshold), clamped to >= 0.0.
Call TrigTableLookup(this) to obtain the curve-shape modifier used to blend the two ramp arms.
Blend the ramp arms and scale: (TrigTableLookup(this) * (v3 * 0.25 - v2 * 0.25) + v2 * 0.25) * 58.5.
Return the evaluated friction value (58.5, 0.0, or the interpolated curve value).
